releaseNotes: Fixed accidental outside/adjacent-tap dismissal & snoozing in the update dialog by disabling dismissOnClickOutside and widening the Update Now button.
Fixed silent failures when launching Android Unknown Sources Settings or the PackageInstaller confirmation sheet by adding ordered intent fallbacks and visible Retry errors.
Added verified cached-APK reuse, synchronous duplicate-download locking across permission callbacks, and an Open System Installer fallback button.
